title: Big picture, round 5: Areas matches the other views

steps.path: Big picture → Areas, as it opens
steps.headline: Areas, first view: status pills in "What most things are waiting on".
steps.changed: Each row there now ends with the same tinted status pill as the other three views, instead of a small dot at the start. "Became real in the last month" lost its dots: every row there exists, so a mark on each said nothing.
steps.notice: The mission card and the area cards are unchanged.

steps.path: Big picture → Areas → open Sync and Mesh, first group opened
steps.headline: Inside an area: folded groups of rows instead of boxes of chips.
steps.changed: Each group ("Everything follows you") is one folded row with "4 of 9 exist". Opened, it lists its items as rows with a status pill and which line of work they belong to, plus a button for the group's details.
steps.notice: Same look as Journeys, Foundations and How it works. Click any row for its popup.
steps.risk: The lines that used to connect related items when you clicked one are gone; the popup lists what an item needs and what needs it instead.

steps.headline: The three quick lists use the same rows and pills.
steps.changed: What's blocked, Built twice and Shipped this month show boxed rows with a pill; names in "Waits on" are separated by semicolons, since the names themselves contain commas.
steps.notice: Nothing else on these lists changed.
